chk_container_project_placement.name: chk_container_project_placement
chk_container_project_placement.value: ("containers"."type" IN ('LOUNGE', 'DM') AND "containers"."project_id" IS NULL) OR ("containers"."type" IN ('ROOM', 'WORKSPACE'))

idx_messages_container_created_at.name: idx_messages_container_created_at
idx_messages_container_created_at.where: "messages"."container_id" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."deleted_at" IS NULL

idx_messages_channel_created_at.name: idx_messages_channel_created_at
idx_messages_channel_created_at.where: "messages"."channel_id" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."deleted_at" IS NULL

chk_message_target_xor.name: chk_message_target_xor
chk_message_target_xor.value: ("messages"."container_id" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."channel_id" IS NULL) OR ("messages"."container_id" IS NULL AND "messages"."channel_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_message_e2ee_zero_knowledge.name: chk_message_e2ee_zero_knowledge
chk_message_e2ee_zero_knowledge.value: ("messages"."is_encrypted" = true AND "messages"."ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."plaintext_body" IS NULL AND "messages"."structured_payload" IS NULL) OR ("messages"."is_encrypted" = false)
